title: Creative Leadership and Innovative Thinking
overview: Creative leadership and innovative management are essential for driving success within organizations and for personal growth. These competencies can be nurtured and developed in any individual, provided they have the right environment and support. This workshop is designed to help you cultivate these skills in yourself and inspire the same in others. It also addresses personal challenges and aspirations related to creative leadership, offering tailored solutions that work specifically for you.
audience: This course is ideal for supervisors, managers, team and project leaders, and anyone who needs to adopt a more creative approach at work—whether it’s for problem-solving, launching new initiatives, or implementing change.
methodology: The workshop employs a coaching-based approach to achieve its learning objectives, supplemented by group activities, team exercises, and case studies to reinforce understanding and application.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand the connection between effective leadership and creativity and innovation
Apply self-awareness techniques to unlock their natural creative potential
Guide and support others in developing the self-awareness necessary for creativity
Create an environment that nurtures and encourages creativity and innovation in others
Utilize various tools and techniques to generate creative and innovative ideas
